title: ANC4 Coverage: Gaya vs Nalanda (2021–2023)
question: How did the share of registered pregnancies completing four or more antenatal checkups change for Gaya and Nalanda between 2021 and 2023, measured in percentage points?

view.title: ANC4 Coverage: Gaya vs Nalanda (2021–2023)
view.note: Each line shows the percentage of registered pregnancies that completed four or more antenatal visits. The vertical gap between the 2021 and 2023 points for a district is the change in percentage points (for example, a move from 50% to 55% is a 5-percentage-point increase, not a 5% increase).

insight_specs.message: This data shows how coverage changed for Gaya and Nalanda but cannot explain why the change occurred.

insights.label: What this data cannot answer
insights.text: This file shows differences and changes, but it has no explanatory variables and cannot establish why they occurred.

source.provenance: Deterministic synthetic district-level ANC fixture created for the benchmark; no people or sensitive records. District names are illustrative and values are not official statistics.
